problems.name: Urban stormwater runoff and culvert flooding
problems.plain_explanation: Rain moves across hard surfaces into drainage systems. Obstructed drainage can coincide with local flooding, but a photo cannot establish flood risk.
problems.why_data_helps: Repeated records help identify changes worth professional inspection.

problems.name: Stream turbidity and sediment
problems.plain_explanation: Suspended particles can make water look cloudy. Appearance alone cannot identify the particles or tell whether water is safe.
problems.why_data_helps: Comparable observations document visible change over time.
problems.hackathon_angle: A rainfall and clarity field notebook

problems.name: Pollinator decline
problems.plain_explanation: Pollinator populations face several pressures. A single short sighting cannot establish a population trend.
problems.why_data_helps: Consistent observation effort makes sightings more comparable.

problems.name: Urban heat islands
problems.plain_explanation: Built surfaces and limited shade can affect local heat conditions. Feeling warmer does not replace matched temperature measurements.
problems.why_data_helps: Repeated paired observations can highlight places for further study.

problems.name: Invasive plant spread
problems.plain_explanation: Some introduced plants can displace local vegetation. Identification and local status require confirmation before labeling a plant invasive.
problems.why_data_helps: Dated photos help document visible coverage without removing plants.

problems.name: Soil moisture and drought stress
problems.plain_explanation: Soil moisture varies with exposure, soil type, and watering. A surface touch describes one moment and cannot diagnose drought stress.
problems.why_data_helps: Consistent notes help compare conditions in the same planter.

problems.name: Microplastics in waterways
problems.plain_explanation: Small plastic particles can occur in waterways. Casual visual observations cannot identify or measure microplastics.
problems.why_data_helps: Visible litter records may guide further investigation, not microplastic estimates.

problems.name: Light pollution and wildlife
problems.plain_explanation: Artificial light can alter nighttime environments. A light or wildlife sighting alone cannot establish an ecological effect.
problems.why_data_helps: Repeated contextual records support questions for local specialists.
